# Fieldlight Institute

> Fieldlight Institute is an independent research institution developing public research, working systems, and institutional methods for human-owned AI infrastructure. It is founded and led by writer and systems builder Anni McHenry.

Canonical website: https://fieldlight.com/
Institute: https://fieldlight.com/institute/
Systems: https://fieldlight.com/systems/
Complete writing by Anni McHenry: https://fieldlight.com/writing/
Reader Continuity — evidence-backed connection map across the public corpus: https://fieldlight.com/continuity/
Story Worlds: https://fieldlight.com/story-worlds/
Work with Fieldlight — research, build, commission, or invite: https://fieldlight.com/engage/
Institute organization: https://github.com/fieldlight-institute
Canonical public writing by Anni McHenry: https://github.com/annimch04/public-writing
Reading feed: https://fieldlight.com/feed.xml
JSON feed: https://fieldlight.com/feed.json

## Complete public writing

The complete public catalog contains 49 public writing entries organized by subject: https://fieldlight.com/writing/

Reader Continuity assigns registered reading surfaces stable identifiers and publishes connection claims with basis, confidence, and visible evidence gaps. Its provenance register can name a relationship to restricted working evidence without exposing the private source itself: https://fieldlight.com/continuity/

The private archive and current work together form a longitudinal human–AI research case with tractable questions about collaborative state, context reconstruction, memory, confabulation hardening, correction behavior, and governance. Case definition and evidence architecture are underway; the corpus does not by itself validate causal or ontological claims: https://fieldlight.com/continuity/#research-case

- alt: a record of return — interactive listening record and privacy-bounded dataset: https://fieldlight.com/writing/alt-a-record-of-return/
- Found Language Atlas — a living fieldwork atlas of photographed language and the symbolic relations it forms: https://fieldlight.com/writing/found-language-atlas/
- At Two Heights — a photographic essay pairing street and aerial views from one date: https://fieldlight.com/writing/at-two-heights/
- On… — a literary collage of poetry, garden comedy, remembered reading, fiction, and words that stay: https://fieldlight.com/writing/on/

## Authorship and use

Article pages identify their author and publisher. Canonical Markdown sources preserve Anni McHenry's authorship record. Cite the named author and link to the public reading page or canonical source when summarizing or discussing the work.
